chain.title: The Currency of the Dead
chain.desc: Smelted, dropped by Soulmasses and Dark Sorcerers, and stocked in the Cathedral of Resurrection chests.

chain.title: Iron Bound With Souls
chain.desc: Iron ingots ringed with Lost Souls; the base metal for soul armour, robes and most translucent weapons.

chain.title: Shinier Than Diamond
chain.desc: Mined from Moonstone Ore and its deepslate variant, or dropped by the Fallen Icon.

chain.title: False Water, Frozen Solid
chain.desc: Cut from Verglas Ore; a cold, smooth material with a liquid trapped inside it.

chain.title: A Convincing Fake
chain.desc: Moonstone and sticks make a greatsword that looks the part but still lacks any real power.

chain.title: A Skull With Iron Teeth
chain.desc: Bone, iron and a Lost Soul; the keystone of the Old Moon Altar.

chain.title: The Old Moon Altar
chain.desc: Iron Skulls, Moonstone and Obsidian; right-clicking it with a Lost Soul calls something back from the grave.

chain.title: Last Arrival
chain.desc: The Returning Knight answers a Lost Soul offered at the Old Moon Altar and drops an Arkenstone, Nightfall, a Lord Soul and Soul Ingots.

chain.title: A Vessel for Infinite Soul
chain.desc: Dropped by the Returning Knight; its lore claims the stored energy could fuel a golem for centuries.

chain.title: Command Your Own Undead
chain.desc: The Returning Knight's greatsword drop, and the third-time-lucky reward of that fight.

chain.title: The Frenzied Shade
chain.desc: Its loot table yields the Essence of Eventide and the dark Lord Soul carrying the old champion's last will.

chain.title: It Wants to Go Home
chain.desc: A shard that longs to return to something; the tooltip points it at the Old Moon Altar.

chain.title: Blue Steel
chain.desc: Returning the Essence of Eventide to the altar summons the Fallen Icon, whose second phase is the Harbinger of Moonlight.

chain.title: All He Could Do Was Listen
chain.desc: A Fallen Icon drop, alongside a white Lord Soul, a Moonlight Greatsword and Moonstone.

chain.title: From the Software Itself
chain.desc: Smithing a Bluemoon Greatsword with any Lord Soul turns the fake into the real thing.

chain.title: Moonlight Without Compromise
chain.desc: The Essence of Luminescence smithed onto a Moonlight sword; the final tier of the moon line.

chain.title: Four Hearts, One Slab
chain.desc: Four Molten Demon Hearts, each smelted from a Demon Heart dropped by Withered Demons.

chain.title: A Stand for Something Old
chain.desc: Moonstone, Ender Pearls, Obsidian and Polished Blackstone Bricks; using a Demon Chunk on it summons a long-lost king.

chain.title: End the Decaying King's Suffering
chain.desc: The Decaying King drops the red Lord Soul, a Withered Demon Heart and the Darkin Blade itself.

chain.title: Bloodthirster, Corrupted
chain.desc: Smithing a Lord Soul onto a Bloodthirster; the Bloodthirster itself is forged from Crimson Ingots and a demon heart.

chain.title: Contained Nebula
chain.desc: Essence of Luminescence, a Withered Demon Heart, an Arkenstone and the Crown of Chaos; thrown skyward it calls two deities.

chain.title: Deity of the Daylight
chain.desc: One half of the duo the Chaos Orb summons; she drops Dawnbreaker and her own Lord Soul.

chain.title: She Promised Godhood
chain.desc: The other half, dropping the Forlorn Scythe, the Soul Reaper and the night Lord Soul.

chain.title: Both Sisters in One Blade
chain.desc: Soul Ingots and Verglas around both the Day Stalker and Night Prowler Lord Souls; the only recipe in the mod that demands them together.

notes: Item set = 255 stems of assets/soulsweapons/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys across every assets/*/lang/en_us.json (168 ids); entity ids for the kill: steps come from the 64 entity.soulsweapons.* keys in the same lang file, so returning_knight (Returning Knight), night_shade (Frenzied Shade), moonknight (Fallen Icon, phase two Harbinger of Moonlight), accursed_lord_boss (The Decaying King), day_stalker and night_prowler are all verified registered entity names. Crafting read from data/soulsweapons/recipes/** (131 files): soul_ingot from iron plus #forge:lost_soul, bluemoon_greatsword from moonstone, altar_block from iron_skull/moonstone/obsidian, blackstone_pedestal from moonstone/blackstone/ender pearl/obsidian, moonlight_greatsword smithed from bluemoon_greatsword plus #soulsweapons:lord_soul, pure_moonlight_greatsword smithed from #soulsweapons:upgradable_moonlight_swords plus essence_of_luminescence, darkin_blade smithed from bloodthirster plus a lord soul, chaos_orb shapeless from essence_of_luminescence + withered_demon_heart + arkenstone + chaos_crown, demon_chunk from four molten_demon_heart, and frostmourne requiring lord_soul_day_stalker AND lord_soul_night_prowler together. Boss drops confirmed in data/soulsweapons/loot_tables/entities/: returning_knight -> arkenstone, lord_soul_rose, nightfall, soul_ingot; night_shade -> essence_of_eventide, lord_soul_dark; moonknight -> essence_of_luminescence, lord_soul_white, moonlight_greatsword, moonstone; accursed_lord_boss -> darkin_blade, lord_soul_red, withered_demon_heart; day_stalker -> dawnbreaker, lord_soul_day_stalker; night_prowler -> forlorn_scythe, lord_soul_night_prowler, soul_reaper; chaos_monarch -> chaos_crown, chaos_robes, lord_soul_void, withered_wabbajack, blood_vial_recipe_page; withered_demon -> demon_heart. Summoning conditions come from the item tooltips in lang (demon_chunk 'Use on the Blackstone Pedestal to summon a long, lost king', essence_of_eventide 'Perhaps bringing it to the Old Moon Altar may do something', chaos_orb 'Throw it into the sky to summon deities of night and day', shard_of_uncertainty 'It seems to perfectly fit in a certain pedestal') and from the advancement tree in data/soulsweapons/advancements/ (root -> draugr_boss -> moonknight; root -> returning_knight -> arkenplate -> infused_arkenplate; demon_heart -> bloodthirsty -> end_of_reigns -> chaos_orb -> kill_day_night_boss; uncertainty -> ender_of_world_ender). Collection 1 is the full soulsweapons:lord_soul item tag plus lord_soul_purple, which is registered and named but has no loot table or recipe anywhere in the jar - it is kept because it is a member of the lord_soul tag and every lord-soul recipe accepts it. Collection 2 is weapons whose recipe ingredient list contains #soulsweapons:lord_soul. Collection 3 is the mod's armour sets. Nothing dropped. moddb agreement: 25 of moddb's 26 ids are inside the verified set and the broad shape matches (moonstone, lord souls and soul_ingot early; boss_compass, mjolnir, gatling_gun, sting late). Conflict: moddb ranks soulsweapons:chungus_emerald at pos 0.000, the very first entry, but it is a joke item from the Moderately Sized Chungus and the cathedral loot table and gates nothing, so it is excluded here; moddb also puts lord_soul_purple at 0.039 near the start although no source for it exists in the jar.
